name: experience_timeline
title: Experience Timeline
description: Vertical journey timeline that merges work (data_items_job.json) and education (data_items_education.json) items: newest on top with a pulsing 'Now' marker, oldest at the bottom. Years sit on the center line, cards alternate left / right (single column on mobile), each tinted with the item's brand color. Line fills and cards slide in while scrolling.
